CLM.description: Ownership Claim Record - one claimant's signed statement over one object.

CLAIMANT_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the claiming party.

CLAIMANT_PROFILE_CID.description: Content identifier of the claiming party's identity record.

Satellite.description: A space object carried in a space object catalog.

Site.description: A fixed or mobile ground site.

Service.description: A service offering published as a listing.

OBJECT_ID.description:
Identifier of the claimed object, in the form its own standard publishes:
the catalog number or international designator for a space object, the
site identifier for a site, the sensor identifier for a sensor, the
listing content identifier for a service.

OBJECT_NAME.description: Human-readable name of the claimed object at the time of the claim.

Owner.description: The claimant holds title to the object.

Operator.description: The claimant operates or commands the object, with or without title.

Provider.description: The claimant provides the service the claim references.

STATEMENT.description: Free-text statement by the claimant, in the claimant's own words.

EVIDENCE_URL.description: Locator of publicly checkable evidence supporting the claim.

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the claim was first made.

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this record was last updated.

DELETED.description: True when this record tombstones the claim from the current set.

SIGNATURE.description:
Claimant signature over the canonical claim form with SIGNATURE and
COUNTERSIGNATURES cleared.

COUNTERSIGNATURES.description: Attestations to this claim by other parties.
